speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Now that the wind park is operational, we have begun monitoring its effects on migratory birds.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The nearby Ramsar wetland is an important resting site for more than 20,000 migratory birds.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Among them is the red knot, a critically endangered species that relies on this area during its migration.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: We have already observed changes in some traditional flight and resting routes around the wind park.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: There is also a significant risk of birds colliding with the turbine blades.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has international obligations to protect migratory birds and the ecological character of the Ramsar wetland.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The Bonn Convention also requires particular attention to endangered migratory species such as the red knot.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The wind park therefore creates a significant challenge for SDG 15.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The question is how we can reduce bird mortality while allowing the wind park to continue contributing to Arcadia's energy transition.
